resources.string: Management identity
Device Guard exempts the management transport from blocking. This screen shows whether that exemption rests on a signing certificate that was checked, or only on a package name.

Before you pin

Pinning records whatever is installed on this device right now as approved. Do it only on a device you have confirmed is clean — freshly provisioned, or checked against a digest the vendor published. If the installed application is already an impostor, pinning it approves the impostor permanently.

The management exemption is granted while an installed signing certificate keeps matching. A signer change withdraws it at the next apply.
Any application installed under this package name inherits the management exemption. Approve the release signing certificate to close that gap.

Management privilege is withheld. The package is hidden rather than exempted, and applying policy is reported as unverified until the installed signer matches an approved certificate or the approved list is corrected.

Remove this approved certificate?

If no approved certificate is left, this package goes back to being trusted by its name alone. If another certificate stays approved and the installed signer does not match it, management privilege is withheld at the next apply.
